title: Attn: latency-contour kernel with adaptive KV snapshots and KV-throttle scheduler
author: Nina Patel
description: Motivation: We see persistent tail-latency spikes for mixed sequence workloads (chat + long documents) when the scheduler selects a single tiling kernel and a monolithic KV cache policy. This PR introduces a latency-contour attention kernel that adapts tiling/warp-layout at dispatch time based on incoming sequence-length distribution and a lightweight adaptive KV snapshotting mechanism to reduce KV contention and cold-KV stalls. It also adds a KV-throttle scheduler that smooths hot-path KV writes under bursty workloads. Changes are designed to be backward-compatible with existing kernel selection interfaces and to be toggled via runtime flags.
commits: Initial prototype: latency-contour dispatch + microkernel dispatcher (Nina)
KV snapshot store and eviction hinting (Nina)

review_thread:
2025-11-19 Miguel: Can you justify the new branch heuristic? The heuristic currently uses a 3-bin sequence-length histogram aggregated per-second; what about workloads with bimodal spikes shorter than the aggregation window?
2025-11-19 Nina: Good point. I added a secondary short-window sample (200ms) that can force a fast-path microkernel when recent samples are heavily weighted toward short sequences. See contour_dispatcher.cpp lines 120-210.
2025-11-20 Asha: Snapshot lifecycle looks okay but I'm worried about memory growth under pathological KV churn. Can we bound snapshots per-model?
2025-11-20 Nina: Added per-model snapshot caps and an LRU hint to prefer reusing recent snapshots. See kv_snapshot_store.h and tests.
2025-11-21 Tom: Benchmarks show ~12% overall throughput uplift for 512/2048 mixed workloads and 18% p99 tail latency reduction on our staging fleet. Can we add a longer run to rule out variance?
2025-11-22 Nina: Extended bench run to 30 minutes on the same instance types; results are stable within ±1.5%. Attached the full CSV in the benchmark job artifact.
2025-11-23 Miguel: CI flake on Windows build for one test; seems unrelated. Approving after fix.
2025-11-24 Asha: Small nits in comments and docs addressed. Approving. Merge by squash.
release_notes: Introduced a latency-contour attention kernel that adaptively picks tiling/warp-layout at dispatch time, an adaptive KV snapshot store to reduce KV cold stalls, and a KV-throttle scheduler to smooth hotspot writes. Expected impact: lower p50/p95 tail latency for mixed sequence workloads and improved throughput for mid/long sequences. Rollout: opt-in via flags; gradual rollout recommended.
